```sql
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        winner AS team,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM matches
    WHERE winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY season, winner
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        MAX(wins) AS max_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY season
)
SELECT
    tw.season,
    tw.team,
    tw.wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN max_wins mw
  ON tw.season = mw.season
 AND tw.wins = mw.max_wins
ORDER BY tw.season;
```
